data.exact_reserve_text: For Syndicate 1209, favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of $8.5m was experienced driven predominantly from favourable experience and IBNR reductions on Energy, Aerospace and Marine lines which were partially offset by unfavourable experience observed on Casualty and Professional lines of business.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a favourable run-off deviation (release) of $8.5m in prior accident year reserves. This was primarily driven by favourable experience and IBNR reductions in Energy, Aerospace, and Marine lines, partially offset by unfavourable experience in Casualty and Professional Lines. The figure has been converted to GBP using an estimated average exchange rate for 2017 and is likely a net figure after reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release)
IBNR reductions on Energy, Aerospace and Marine lines
unfavourable experience observed on Casualty and Professional lines of business

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure of $8.5m is stated in USD and is likely a net figure (after reinsurance). It has been converted to GBP using an estimated average exchange rate of 1.29 USD/GBP for 2017. The claims development triangle does not provide prior year estimates for diagonal comparison, so it could not be used to derive a gross PYD figure. Gross premium mix includes negative values as presented in the source document.
